questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Which countries in Europe drink the most alcohol
Giving up alcohol and the benefits of not drinking
How to make good New Year's resolutions and keep them
Why people drink more at Christmas than at other times
questions.why: Rob and Catherine discuss quitting drinking and staying 'dry', starting with Catherine's dry January.

questions.q: Why is Catherine having a dry January?
options: Her doctor told her to stop drinking
She wants to write a book about it
She lost a bet with Rob
To improve her health and save some money
questions.why: Catherine says she's doing it to improve her health and save some money.

questions.q: What benefit has Catherine already noticed?
options: She has lost some weight she put on at Christmas
She has more energy for sport and goes to the gym
Her skin looks much better than it did in December
She has saved enough money for a holiday abroad
questions.why: She says she has shed some weight, most of which she put on over Christmas.

questions.q: What did Dr Richard de Visser's study find?
options: Most people started drinking again after a week
People spent 62% less money in a month
62% of people slept better after a month without alcohol
857 people decided to stop drinking for good
questions.why: After a month without alcohol, 62% of the people in the study said they slept better.

questions.q: Why does Rob say he won't stop drinking?
options: He says a drink helps him relax and be more social
He thinks one month is too short to make a difference
He says he doesn't drink very much anyway
He thinks sleep is not a problem for him
questions.why: Rob says he needs a drink to help him relax and be more sociable, because he's shy.

questions.q: What does Catherine suggest when she replies 'Yes of course Rob!'?
options: She agrees that drinking helps shy people
She doesn't really believe that Rob is shy
She is worried about Rob's health
She thinks Rob should join her dry January
questions.why: Her reply to 'you know how shy I am' is teasing, suggesting she doesn't think Rob is shy.

questions.q: According to Catherine Gray, why did she drink so much before?
options: Her job required her to drink at every meeting
She was bored at work
She enjoyed the taste of expensive wine
It helped her deal with feeling nervous at parties
questions.why: She had social anxiety and used drinking as a 'confidence crutch' for big parties.

questions.q: How long does Catherine Gray recommend giving up alcohol for?
options: 30 days
66 days
90 days
A whole year
questions.why: She says a new habit takes 66 days to bed in, so she recommends trying it for 90 days.
